text_post: Hello, I'm with CAFE Western Ontario and we have an event upcoming in London. The event is titled "Our Boys are in Crisis". The subject is why our boys are struggling in school and what we can do about it. It is a presentation for teachers, parents, caregivers; anyone involved, however peripherally with the education of boys. This will take the form of a talk, with questions after delivered by Dr. James S. Brown (MA, MEd, EdD), who is an experienced educator and author of such titles as "Rescuing Our Underachieving Sons". The event will be held tuesday, Sept 12, at 7pm, at the Central Branch of the London Public Library, located at 251 Dundas Street. Admission is $10 or $5, with the donation of a non-perishable item for the CAFE Food Drive. Thank you for your time and I hope to see you there!
